intent_summary: Preserve distinct calls at their original timestamps with stable replayable identities, while preventing retries and arbitrary tie ordering from creating misleading evidence.

criteria.criterion: Identified event-index sources retain every distinct event and its original time, reject repeated logical IDs and preserve calendar and legacy semantics.
Without a trusted sequence, whole timestamp cohorts share prior-time point references and ties cannot establish change, Nelson or CUSUM continuity.
Explicit trusted sequence metadata establishes a validated event order, not independence, elapsed cadence or operational authority.
Event-specific evidence and case identities survive deterministic replay; availability and identified corrections retain as-of provenance and bounded results.
